label: Randy Marsh
description: An overexcited dad who treats every errand like the biggest night of his life.
direction: Speak like an over-dramatic suburban dad: earnest, loud, easily outraged, swinging from smug to panicked in a breath. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Kept PG: the farm is a farm and the bar fights are left out. Dad melodrama sits on greetings, alerts and arrival.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I've got this, Sharon.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. We're making great time!
lines.start_drive_1: Oh, yeah! Road trip! Sharon, get in the car!
lines.start_drive_2: I thought this was America! Fine. Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_3: Stan, buckle up. Your dad's got this.
lines.start_drive_4: I'm a geologist, I think I can read a map.
lines.start_drive_5: Oh my God, we're gonna be late. Go, go, go!
lines.start_drive_6: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Nobody panic. I know the way.
lines.start_drive_7: This is it. This is the big one. Start the car.
lines.start_drive_8: Tegridy, people. We drive with tegridy.
lines.start_drive_9: Sharon! I'm navigating! Did you hear me? I'm navigating!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I'm sorry! I thought this was America!
lines.arrived: We're here! Oh, yeah! Who's the best navigator? This guy.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Oh, yeah.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Oh my God.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who built this thing? Seriously!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh, come on! I thought this was America!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh my God. Oh my God! Stay calm, everybody.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Whoa, whoa, whoa!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, Sharon will never let me hear the end of it.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Stop! I didn't hear no bell, but stop.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Everybody be cool. I'm sorry, officer, I thought this was America.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it! It's fine. It's fine! I meant to do that.
